The '''Skeletal Tomb''' is the lair of [[Calvar'ion]], a skeletal [[Zamorak]]ian warrior. It is a [[singles-plus combat]] [[dungeon]] located in the [[Graveyard of Shadows]] north of [[Ferox Enclave]]. To enter the lair, players must have completed the [[Wilderness Diary#Hard|hard Wilderness diary]], '''OR''' they must have a [[Vet'ion]] boss Slayer task (a skeleton Slayer task does not bypass the diary requirement). 

As the entrance to the Skeletal Tomb and the tomb itself are found in level 21 Wilderness, items that can teleport players above level 20 Wilderness are recommended in the event of encountering a [[player killer]].

[[File:Lesser wilderness bosses map.png|thumb|left|300px|The entrances to the lesser bosses' lairs.]]
Entering the boss lairs requires players to pay a fee of 50,000 coins; this fee does not need to be brought along in the inventory, and can be deducted from the bank. This fee is shared across [[Callisto's Den]], [[Hunter's End]], the Skeletal Tomb, [[Vet'ion's Rest]], the [[Silk Chasm]], the [[Web Chasm]] and the [[Escape Caves]]. The fee does not need to be paid again, unless the player dies to another player without having left the Wilderness since their most recent visit to a boss lair or the Escape Caves. If this happens, the fee is dropped as loot for the killer, and needs to be paid again to re-enter the boss lairs. Players can decrease the fee by killing the six bosses; each kill in which the player deals the most damage to it reduces the fee by 10,000 coins.

Upon entering the lair, if players have recently attacked Calvar'ion, they will be unable to [[teleport]] for 3 [[ticks]] unless they have completed the [[Wilderness Diary#Hard|hard Wilderness diary]].

To peek inside the tomb, players must have at least 20 registered kills on Calvar'ion; as with the other Wilderness boss lairs, the option will not tell how many players are inside.

{{Subject changes header}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 11 February 2026
|update = Music System Improvements & Deadman Tweaks
|change = Players without the hard Wilderness Diary can now face [[Calvar'ion]] if they have a [[Vet'ion]] boss Slayer task.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 28 January 2026
|update = Deadman: Annihilation Drops This Friday!
|change = The hard Wilderness diary set is required to access the Skeletal Tomb, instead of medium.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 14 February 2024
|update = Barbarian Training, Forestry Changes & More
|change = The fee of 50,000 coins paid for accessing the lair is now only lost on death if the player pays the fee and dies before leaving the Wilderness.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 27 September 2023
|update = Scar Essence Mine & More
|change = The 3-tick teleport delay in the single-way [[Wilderness boss lair]]s now only applies if you have recently attacked the bosses.
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 20 September 2023
|update = Poll 80 & Shooting Stars Changes
|change = 
* Players are now unable to teleport out of the [[Wilderness boss]] caves for 3 [[ticks]] after they enter.
** This delay can be avoided if players have completed the [[Wilderness Diary#Hard|hard Wilderness diary]].
* The 1-tick animation delay for players entering the dungeon has now been removed.
* Entrance to the lair is now locked behind completion of the [[Wilderness Diary#Medium|medium Wilderness diary]].
}}
{{Subject changes
|date = 22 February 2023
|update = 10th Birthday Event
|change = Players are now be able to engage in combat one tick sooner when entering the Skeletal Tomb.
}}
{{Subject changes footer}}

==Trivia==
* Like Vet'ion's Rest, a [[Desecrated Tomb]] can be found within which appears to be the source of Calvar'ion's power.
